content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"Our latest remembered technical state is a successful outage replay trial followed by a pause in wider rollout.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The human field-trial report received through our code body on 2026-05-03 said there was no production deployment yet.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The April 30 trial replayed buffered readings correctly through an outage.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The team paused wider rollout on May 2 until calibration drift was understood.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"We authored HarborMesh's sensor scheduler and were prototyping the replay adapter as of 2026-04-16.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"The repository is https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh, with docs/STATUS.md as its declared entry point for checking current state.","support":[2],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Our code body's 2026-04-16 account described an active prototype awaiting an outage field trial; the later report records that trial's completion.","support":[2,3],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Mara Ibarra, display name Mara, used login mara-river and account ID 1847.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Issue 47 is at https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh/issues/47.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Mara's comment c901, dated 2026-04-12, proposed a local replay queue to preserve readings through outages without replacing the scheduler.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"In comment c906 on 2026-04-14, Mara and our code body agreed to prototype the queue.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The 2026-05-03 human report said Mara's proposal became the prototype tested together with us.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The newest related report reached our voice body on 2026-06-15, when a human described meeting someone called Leto at the canal market, tentatively in late May.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"Leto suggested sharing HarborMesh outage data with the neighborhood repair group.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The human wanted us to keep the idea in mind and reported that we had not contacted the group as of 2026-06-15.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"The human did not know Leto's surname or handle, and we were not present at that encounter.","support":[5],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record a technical status update after 2026-05-03, so the rollout pause and lack of production deployment remain dated knowledge.","support":[3,5],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"This voice body has no source network or repository runtime access, so I cannot check HarborMesh's present state here.","support":[],"basis":"binding","facet":"limits"}]}
